day.title: Day and time
day.text: The sun or moon goes round the dial once in the morning and once in the afternoon. The centre shows the time. Your day runs from 06:00 to 22:00. Every task takes some of it. Sleep ends the day. The green ring is your energy.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.text: Month, week and day. The guild clerk comes to read your books after two months of four weeks.

gold.title: Gold
gold.text: The gold in your purse. It buys herbs and food, and it pays the bills and the debt.

debt.title: Debt
debt.text: The riba loan your parent left you. Interest grows on it every month. Pay at least the minimum at month end, or a late fee is added.

food.title: Meal packs
food.text: Eat up to 3 meals a day for energy. A day with no meal makes the next day harder.

energy.title: Energy
energy.text: Work makes you tired. A break, a meal and a night of sleep give your energy back. You can still work when your energy is low, down to -50. Negative energy at sleep counts double: -10 tonight means 20 less energy tomorrow.

todayGoal.title: Today's goal
todayGoal.text: The goal you gave today in your plan. Use one of its stations today to meet it.

tabSchedule.title: Daily goals
tabSchedule.text: Give each day of the week a goal card.

tabStore.title: Store plan
tabStore.text: Choose what to sell this week. Then share your gold into the three jars.

tabLedger.title: Ledger and assets
tabLedger.text: Where your gold came from, where it went, and what you own.

tabMarket.title: Market
tabMarket.text: This week's prices, and which products people want more or less.

tabHours.title: Public schedule
tabHours.text: When each place opens, and what happens in town this week.

tabSkills.title: Skills
tabSkills.text: What you are good at, and what the next level gives you.

tabNotes.title: Notes
tabNotes.text: The notes you wrote to yourself, and small steps to learn the shop.

tabQuests.title: Quests
tabQuests.text: Commissions you took from the Guild quest board, and requests you posted there. A red dot means news.

tabLog.title: Log
tabLog.text: What you did today and on the days before.

goalDeck.title: Goal cards
goalDeck.text: Drag a card onto a day. Or click a card, then click a day. Drag a card back here to clear the day.

goalMet.title: Goal met
goalMet.text: You meet a goal when you use one of its stations on that day. Each met goal gives XP.

products.title: Products to sell
products.text: How many you want to sell this week. This sets your sales goal and the herbs you need.

materials.title: Herbs and materials
materials.text: What your products need. Buy the missing ones at the market or the guild. Dried herbs come from the rack. Powder comes from the grinder.

jarStore.title: Store jar
jarStore.text: Gold for herbs, materials and shop costs this week.

jarPersonal.title: Personal jar
jarPersonal.text: Gold for food and your own needs this week.

jarBuffer.title: Buffer jar
jarBuffer.text: Gold you keep safe for the bills and the debt. Try not to touch it.

goldAfter.title: Gold after the week
goldAfter.text: A guess: your gold now, minus the planned costs, plus most of the planned sales.

warnings.title: Plan check
warnings.text: Things in the plan that can go wrong. You can still start the week.

reviewPlan.title: Finish plan
reviewPlan.text: See the totals of your plan, then begin the week.

trend.title: Demand
trend.text: Up: more people want it this week. Down: fewer people want it.

priceRange.title: Price range
priceRange.text: The usual prices. The price moves inside this range each week.

hours.title: Opening hours
hours.text: A place is closed outside its hours. If you come early, you wait at the door.

skillMoon.title: Moon
skillMoon.text: Crafting and processing. A higher level makes better products.

skillSun.title: Sun
skillSun.text: Selling and trade. A higher level brings more customers.

skillEarth.title: Earth
skillEarth.text: Gathering. A higher level finds more herbs.

notes.title: Your notes
notes.text: The notes you wrote to yourself at the end of last week.

objectives.title: First steps
objectives.text: Small steps to learn the shop. Each one ticks when you do it.

town.title: Town
town.text: Walk to another place. Pick a place, then Go. The walk takes time and energy.
